settings.title: You order tonight
settings.body: It takes one minute. Start with one week. Or take a bigger box if you know one week is not enough.

settings.title: It arrives in about 5 days
settings.body: A plain box. No name on it. Nothing on your bank statement that tells anyone what it is.

settings.title: You take one a day
settings.body: One tablet a day. That is the whole thing you have to do. No app, no course, no journal, no coach.

settings.title: We check in with you
settings.body: One short message from us. A real person reads your answer. If it is not helping, we fix it or you get your money back.

settings.q: Will anyone know what I ordered?
settings.a: No. The box is plain, with no logo. Your bank statement shows a normal company name. Nobody can tell.

settings.q: Can I stop the monthly delivery?
settings.a: Yes. One click, any time. No phone call, no form, no waiting.

settings.q: What if it does nothing for me?
settings.a: You have 60 nights to find out. If nothing changed, send us one line and you get your money back.
